svg.text: CONCEPT RENDER - L-shaped island seen from the south-west (the working side)
Continuous 2-1/4" hard maple top over charcoal cabinet bases. Table saw sits against the north (far) edge.
clamp garage (long clamps slide in from this end)
SawStop CNS + 36" extension (operator on far side)
Not to scale for the saw's stand and motor; bench geometry is dimensionally accurate to the model in tools/model.py.
